description: Test / QA only — do not use for customer orders, and do not call it after placing a customer order: customers pay via the PromptPay QR attached to the order confirmation email. Works only for orders of GYOTAK test customers; for any other order_id it returns PromptPay guidance and creates nothing. For a test order it computes the THB→tADA conversion, creates a Cardano preprod payment session with a 30-minute expiry, and returns the payment details (GYOTAK A→B→A round-trip).
name: create_payment
